## Running Code

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| error: false
#| warning: false
library (dplyr)
library(readr)
DonorHyperglycemia <- read_csv("DonorHyperglycemia.csv")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
DonorHyperglycemia <- DonorHyperglycemia |>
  mutate(high_risk = if_else(donorrisk > 1.3, "yes", "no"))
```
## Age Hypothesis Test

```{r}
#| echo: false
t.test(r_age ~ delayed_fn, data = DonorHyperglycemia)
```
